name: SLIF/Applicable speed-limit comparison (static web app)
install: echo 'No dependencies to install; the app is static HTML/CSS/JS and Leaflet is loaded from a CDN.'
start: cd /workspace && if ! curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:8000/index.html 2>/dev/null; then nohup python3 -m http.server 8000 >/tmp/static-server.log 2>&1 & fi; for i in $(seq 1 10); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:8000/index.html && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -sf -o /dev/null -w 'static server on :8000 -> HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8000/index.html
